article.title: Laying of rules before State Legislature.
article.content: Every rule made by the State Government under section 223 and section 236 shall be laid, as soon as it is made, before the State Legislature.]
article.html:
236A1[Laying of rules before State Legislature.

Section 236A · Part IX · Chapter I · page 72 of the Act

Every rule made by the State Government under section 223 and section 236 shall be laid, as soon as it is made, before the State Legislature.]

1 Ins. by Act 20 of 1983, s. 2 and Sch. (w.e.f. 15-3-1984).
